response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 9 days ago (<= 15 days), so RET-002 applies and grants eligibility. RET-002 (priority 20) dominates the standard-window RET-007 (priority 10). No higher-priority rules apply: final_sale is False (RET-012 inactive), defective is False (RET-020 inactive), goodwill_grant and fraud_hold are False. The customer's reason for returning (too loud) does not affect eligibility.
